title: Private data processing method, equipment and system for federated learning

pse.problem: The limitation lies in the inability to perform large integer operations (1024-bit or more) using current machine instructions in federated learning.
pse.solution_function: Performs secret calculation on update model parameters using an encryption algorithm like Paillier or RSA, disassembling a first operand into multiple second operands with bit number smaller than the first operand, and performing parallel operations on these second operands. The coordinating device or other participating devices use this information to obtain updated aggregation model parameters.
pse.solution_structure: Includes a processor that performs disassembly of large operands into multiple smaller operands and a communication interface for data exchange with the coordinating device or other participating devices.
pse.solution_implementation: The participating device receives aggregated model parameters, acquires local training data, performs local training, generates ciphertext data by secret calculation on update model parameters using an encryption algorithm, disassembles a large operand into multiple smaller operands, converts the operation of the large operand into parallel operations of the smaller operands, sends the ciphertext data to the coordinating device or other participating devices.
pse.effect: Enables federated learning to operate on larger integer values not natively supported by machine instructions, improving the efficiency and applicability of federated learning
